newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CRA dominates Australian stocks trade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CRA dominates Australian stocks trade.

text.p: Turnover in international mining house CRA Ltd dominated early Friday trade on the Australian Stock Exchange with Bankers Trust handling two parcels of 9.27 million shares, brokers said.
"It is some kind of wash of the dividend," said the head of one institutional dealing desk, who asked not to be identified.
CRA is the dual-listed partner of British mining giant RTZ Plc.

Brokers recently have cited a number of examples where foreign investors temporarily offload their holdings in Australian bluechip firms to local investors who can take advantage of the Australian dividend taxation system.
A spokesman for Bankers Trust was not available for comment.
About 19.21 million CRA shares had traded by 11.20 a.m. (0020 GMT).
The two large parcels were dealt at A$18.42, which was CRA's closing price on Thursday. The stock was 12 cents lower at 11.20 a.m. (0020 GMT) on Friday.
